entity.summary: Dubai-based cryptocurrency exchange subject to VARA enforcement in July 2026 and subsequent U.S. sanctions reporting in August 2026. Public operating status is disputed: Shelbit said it had ceased operations in January 2026, while VARA said in July that the entity had continued providing unlicensed virtual-asset services, so HEI keeps the record inactive rather than dead.
entity.notes: VARA identifies Shelbit General Trading L.L.C as commercially operating as Shelbit or Shelbit Exchange and says it continued providing virtual-asset services in and from Dubai without a valid licence before a July 2026 fine and cease-and-desist direction. Reuters reported that the public website had been unavailable for months, reappeared after its July 31 investigation, and carried a Shelbit statement saying operations had ceased in January 2026. Because those operational signals conflict, HEI does not assign a death date or death reason and uses inactive as the conservative status. Reuters reported activity appearing to begin around May 2024, but no exact launch date is encoded.

events.title: VARA fined Shelbit and ordered an immediate cease and desist
events.description: Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority said Shelbit General Trading L.L.C had continued providing virtual-asset services without a valid licence, onboarding users without required KYC checks and marketing services without authorisation. VARA imposed financial penalties and directed the entity to cease all unlicensed virtual-asset activities in or from Dubai immediately.
events.notes: The enforcement notice establishes a major service constraint but does not by itself establish permanent global shutdown.

events.title: U.S. sanctions were imposed on Shelbit and its founder
events.description: Reuters reported that the U.S. Treasury sanctioned Shelbit, founder Siavash Kayvanpour and associated companies, alleging that Shelbit processed digital assets for Iran-linked sanctioned actors including the IRGC.
events.notes: This event records the sanctions action without using it as a substitute for a verified operational shutdown date.

evidence.title: VARA Notice of Fines – Shelbit General Trading L.L.C
evidence.notes: Primary regulator notice identifies the legal entity and Shelbit trade names, describes continued unlicensed virtual-asset activity and KYC/marketing violations, records financial penalties, and orders an immediate cease and desist.

evidence.title: Illicit Iranian gambling network helped pull off a $4 billion sanctions dodge
evidence.notes: Independent investigation identifies Shelbit as a Dubai-based crypto exchange, reports that the public website was unavailable and public trading access was not identifiable at the time, and corroborates VARA enforcement context.

evidence.title: US sanctions Dubai crypto exchange for aiding Iran's IRGC, following a Reuters report
evidence.notes: Independent reporting records the August 7 U.S. sanctions action and Shelbit's response that it had ceased operations in January 2026, while also noting that the website had reactivated after the July 31 investigation.
